request.prompt:
Goods: Three-phase AC induction motor 0.55kW, 1400 rpm
Country of origin: DE

Chosen so far: 85 Electrical machinery and equipment and parts thereof; sound recorders and reproducers; television image and sound recorders and reproducers, parts and accessories of such articles

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 8501: Electric motors and generators (excluding generating sets)
    contains 850140: Electric motors; AC motors, single-phase
    contains 850153: Electric motors; AC motors, multi-phase, of an output exceeding 75kW
    contains 850151: Electric motors; AC motors, multi-phase, of an output not exceeding 750W
    contains 850152: Electric motors; AC motors, multi-phase, of an output exceeding 750W but not exceeding 75kW
    contains 850133: Electric motors and generators; DC, of an output exceeding 75kW but not exceeding 375kW
    contains 850134: Electric motors and generators; DC, of an output exceeding 375kW
    contains 850132: Electric motors and generators; DC, of an output exceeding 750W but not exceeding 75kW
    contains 850131: Electric motors and generators; DC, of an output not exceeding 750W
    contains 850120: Electric motors; universal AC/DC of an output exceeding 37.5W
- 8514: Industrial or laboratory electric furnaces and ovens (including those functioning by induction or dielectric loss); other industrial or laboratory equipment for the heat treatment of materials by induction or dielectric loss
    contains 851420: Furnaces and ovens; electric, for industrial or laboratory use, functioning by induction or dielectric loss
    contains 851431: Furnaces and ovens; electric, for industrial or laboratory use, other than those functioning by induction, dielectric loss or resistance heated, electron beam furnaces
    contains 851439: Furnaces and ovens; electric, for industrial or laboratory use, other than those functioning by induction, dielectric loss or resistance heated, other than electron beam, plasma or vacuum arc furnaces
    contains 851432: Furnaces and ovens; electric, for industrial or laboratory use, other than those functioning by induction, dielectric loss or resistance heated, plasma and vacuum arc furnaces
    contains 851440: Heating equipment; for the heat treatment of materials by induction or dielectric loss, industrial or laboratory, other than furnaces and ovens

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: A three-phase AC induction motor is an electric motor under heading 8501 (multi-phase AC motor, 550 W, subheading 850151), not an induction heating furnace under 8514.
